title: RWB-S7-E6018-APP: the delegation table and its owner, the approver and the limit applied have no column, the credit committee outcome is claimed by no story, and the plan's C row is empty while five rows are consumed
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6018-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-018; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.1, A1.2, A1.4, A2.6 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-12, R-WO-13, R-WO-14 and R-WO-15; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-06; Business Requirements Program v4 rows REQ-S7-003 and REQ-S7-004
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6018-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case state, answers the rwb-case case move, reads the delegation_limit row, reads the rwb-decision WO package and calls the rwb-access authorise check, so five consumed rows have no plan row and DP-06, DP-07, DP-08 and DP-09 are absent from the pattern set. (2) The delegation_limit table carries reference-data field IDs DF-REF-016 to DF-REF-026 and no source this story may read names its owner, while R-WO-15 and R-WO-12 both turn on the delegation and the write-off committee limit. (3) The approver and the limit applied are required by legacy AC2, yet write_off has no column for either in TSD S7 T3.1 and the FSD S7 A2.6.3.2 field catalog lists only the eight write-off fields; TSD S7 T3.2 publishes no list of values at all. (4) R-WO-12 routes the pack to ESCALATED_TO_CREDIT_COMMITTEE and the credit committee's own approve and reject (R-WO-13, R-WO-14) are claimed by no story of this split, so the escalated state has no exit. (5) EV-24 WriteOffApproved is attributed to this approval step by RWB-S7-E6017-APP and to the posting step by RWB-S7-E6016-CON, and the plan's H row carries no RWB-PLT-TE006-CON. (6) TSD S7 T-A.2 names the answer element DecisionLogEntry while the record the step writes is the local one of DP-03. (7) The committee meeting calendar booked at RWB-S7-E6017-APP has no published source, no write_off column and no Schedule element. (8) MSG-S7-001 is in the legacy message set of this key but belongs to the scan gate R-WO-03. (9) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, decision_log_entry, rule_row and delegation_limit, none of which this service may read or write as a table, and the legacy Endpoints table carries the monolith base. (10) REQ-S7-003 covers the approve, reject and defer together, so no requirement id covers the escalation alone, and REQ-S7-004 belongs to the exception loop that no story of this key claims.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S7-E6018-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-06, DP-07, DP-08 and DP-09 rows; context pack ownership rows (write_off S7, 2 REST operations, event EV-24, job JOB-16, workflow WriteOffWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S7; TSD S7 T-A.1 and T-A.2, T3.1 field list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020, the empty T3.2 list table and T4 state machine; FSD S7 A2.6.3.1, A2.6.3.2, A2.6.3.3 and A2.6.4; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-12, R-WO-13, R-WO-14 and R-WO-15; legacy RWB-E6-018 Data, Endpoints, Acceptance criteria, Permission checks and Guardrails; Business Requirements Program v4 REQ-S7-003 and REQ-S7-004
area: Field definition, reference-data ownership, state exit, event ownership, dependency and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the five consumed rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; read delegation_limit as reference data at its version on the rwb-case contract and the package on the rwb-decision contract; record the approver and the limit applied in the local decision record with no write_off column; carry out of scope and raise R-WO-13 and R-WO-14 as the unclaimed exit of ESCALATED_TO_CREDIT_COMMITTEE; claim EV-24 for the approved path and record the conflict with the posting story; record RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the library the topic needs; carry MSG-S7-001 as a message of the set that no path raises; trace to REQ-S7-003 with the escalation noted as uncovered

title: RWB-S7-E6018-CON: the delegation element, the answer element and the five consumed operation names have no published baseline, and the credit committee outcome is declared nowhere
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6018-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-018; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.6.2, A2.6.3.1, A2.6.3.2, A2.6.4.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-12 and R-WO-15
description: (1) TSD S7 T-A.1 publishes API-S7-002 with the request and answer element names but no property list, and T3.1 gives only the write_off columns, so the decision-record answer, the approver and the limit applied have no published element. (2) delegation_limit has field IDs DF-REF-016 to DF-REF-026 and no owner and no element in any source this story may read. (3) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, and the S7 row of the connection matrix names only Temporal to P7 and P8 with REST and events to P1, so the case move and the delegation read are declared as boundary elements or placeholders. (4) TSD S7 T3.2 is an empty list-of-values table, so the baseline publishes no enumeration, and T-A.2 gives status codes with no message id per condition. (5) TSD S7 T5.3 names WriteOffApproved as published but publishes no payload, no event name and no topic element beyond the naming rule. (6) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares five consumed rows, and DP-09 is absent from the pattern set although an event is declared.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002, T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids, T3.1 field list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 with no approver and no limit applied, the empty T3.2 list table and T5.3 events table; context pack connection-matrix row S7 and naming rules; FSD S7 A2.6.4.4 (no background event beyond the scan); legacy RWB-E6-018 messages MSG-S7-001, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003, its Data table and its Endpoints table
area: Contract surface, element definitions and interface names
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the case boundary as the child workflow's input, signals and stage outcome, declare the delegation element as a consumed reference-data row, declare the event element on rwb.writeoff.events.v1 as rwb.writeoff.WriteOffApproved.v1, record the credit committee outcome as unclaimed, and confirm the element properties with the solution architect before the tag
